children: GoTo Gojek Tokopedia's current valuation looks attractive and provides upside after a technical selloff following the removal of the 50 rupiah price floor by the Indonesian market regulator in late September, says Citi analyst Ferry Wong in a note. The bank closes its negative short-term view and opens a 90-day positive catalyst watch. However, it cuts FY26-28 adjusted Ebitda estimates by 9%, 17% and 20%, respectively, to factor in the government's cap on ride-hailing commissions and potential delivery commissions. Citi lowers the stock's target price to IDR80 from IDR95 but maintains a buy, saying the market appears to assign little value to GOTO's operating businesses. Shares last closed 3.2% lower at IDR30. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
